query:
SELECT d.id, d.name, d.firebaseId, d.userId, u.id as user_id, u.openId 
FROM dealers d 
LEFT JOIN users u ON d.userId = u.id 
WHERE d.id IN (SELECT id FROM dealers LIMIT 5);
